title: Infinitely many prime geodesic images on spheres
exact_target: For every $n\geq 2$ and every smooth Riemannian metric on the standard smooth sphere $S^{n}$, must there be infinitely many geometrically distinct prime closed geodesics? Geometric distinctness means different image sets; simplicity is not required.
